findings.evidence: The model table lists gemini-3-pro-preview, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash and gemini-2.5-flash-lite as peer 'Choose when' rows, while SKILL.md only says a model the user names wins.
findings.fix: Keep gemini-3-pro-preview as the single default in the table and mark the other rows as escape hatches (newest Pro only if /model lists it and the user asks; flash only when the user says latency matters; 2.5 only when preview access is refused).

findings.evidence: The 10 should-trigger queries all name Gemini, Google's model, a second model, or a 300k-400k context, so none tests the description's unnamed case of a repository or document set too large for one context.
findings.fix: Add a should-trigger query that describes only the size problem without naming Gemini or a second model, for example a monorepo the agent cannot hold whose services and shared packages need one architecture pass, and keep a near-miss negative that is merely a large file the agent can read itself.

findings.evidence: Follow-up says to give `timeout --foreground --kill-after=10s 1800 gemini ... -r "latest" "query"` and, without confirmation that --resume combines with -p, to start a new headless run instead. The cited interactive form is `gemini -r "latest" "query"` with a positional prompt, which Gotchas says opens a waiting TTY session, so the proposed command is neither that form nor the headless fallback.
findings.fix: Give the documented interactive resume as `timeout --foreground --kill-after=10s 1800 gemini -m gemini-3-pro-preview --approval-mode default -i "query" -r latest` only if gemini --help shows -i and -r together; otherwise give only the new headless -p run that restates the accepted findings.

findings.evidence: Resources lists https://github.com/google/generative-ai-docs as Gemini CLI Documentation and https://ai.google.dev/docs plus https://ai.google.dev/models/gemini, while SKILL.md's checked behavior claims all cite https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli docs.
findings.fix: Point Resources at the gemini-cli docs pages SKILL.md already cites (cli-reference.md, headless.md, model.md), dated 2026-11-07, and drop the generative-ai-docs and ai.google.dev links unless a fresh check shows they document the CLI.
